[[File:Maple longbow detail.png|left|120px]]
A '''maple longbow''' is created by attaching a [[bow string]] to a [[maple longbow (u)]] with at least level 55 [[Fletching]]. Fletching from a [[maple log]] yields a total of 116.5 experience (58.3 for fletching and 58.2 for stringing). The bow can use arrows up to [[Adamant arrow|adamant]] and requires level 30 [[Ranged]] to wield. 

The maple longbow differs from the [[maple shortbow|shortbow]] only in terms of speed and [[attack range]]. However, the shortbow is preferred over the longbow due to its faster [[attack speed]]. It can also be a reward for the [[Observatory Quest]].

Fletching a maple longbow from [[maple logs]] and a [[bow string]] will profit {{Coins|{{GEP|Maple longbow}}-({{GEP|Maple logs}}+{{GEP|Bow string}})}} while fletching a maple longbow from a [[maple longbow (u)]] and a [[bow string]] will profit {{Coins|{{GEP|Maple longbow}}-({{GEP|Maple longbow (u)}}+{{GEP|Bow string}})}}.
